//@version=6
// ============================================================
//  QUANT PRIME · RESEARCH BUILD RES-3032
//  Prior Week + Hourly Profile + Vol Report
//  Prior week H/L/C, Time-of-day range profile, Volatility report generator
//
//  Generated file. Do not edit.
//  Edit the source piece and regenerate.
//  quantprime.uk
// ============================================================
indicator("QP RES-3032 · Prior Week + Hourly Profile + Vol Report", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500, max_bars_back = 500)

// ---------- STARTER ----------
st3_on   = input.bool(true,      "Show prior week H/L/C",        group = "Starter · Prior week")
st3_cHi  = input.color(#c9a84c,  "High",  inline = "st3", group = "Starter · Prior week")
st3_cLo  = input.color(#00abff,  "Low",   inline = "st3", group = "Starter · Prior week")
st3_cCl  = input.color(#9aa0a6,  "Close", inline = "st3", group = "Starter · Prior week")

[st3_h, st3_l, st3_c] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W", [high[1], low[1], close[1]], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

plot(st3_on ? st3_h : na, "PW High",  color = st3_cHi, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)
plot(st3_on ? st3_l : na, "PW Low",   color = st3_cLo, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)
plot(st3_on ? st3_c : na, "PW Close", color = st3_cCl, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)

// ---------- MAIN ----------
// (none selected)

// ---------- SIDE ----------
sd3_on   = input.bool(true, "Show time-of-day profile",     group = "Side · Time-of-day profile")
sd3_days = input.int(30,    "Days of history", minval = 5,  group = "Side · Time-of-day profile")
sd3_sz   = input.string("Tiny", "Profile text size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = "Side · Time-of-day profile")
sd3_pos  = input.string("Top right", "Profile table position", options = ["Top right", "Top left", "Bottom right", "Bottom left"], group = "Side · Time-of-day profile")

var array<float> sd3_sum = array.new_float(24, 0.0)
var array<int>   sd3_cnt = array.new_int(24, 0)

sd3_cut = timestamp(year, month, dayofmonth, 0, 0) - sd3_days * 86400000
if time >= sd3_cut
    sd3_h = hour(time, syminfo.timezone)
    array.set(sd3_sum, sd3_h, array.get(sd3_sum, sd3_h) + (high - low))
    array.set(sd3_cnt, sd3_h, array.get(sd3_cnt, sd3_h) + 1)

sd3_size = sd3_sz == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : sd3_sz == "Small" ? size.small : sd3_sz == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.large

sd3_where = sd3_pos == "Top right" ? position.top_right : sd3_pos == "Top left" ? position.top_left : sd3_pos == "Bottom right" ? position.bottom_right : position.bottom_left

var table sd3_tbl = table.new(sd3_where, 2, 25, border_width = 0)
if sd3_on and barstate.islast
    table.cell(sd3_tbl, 0, 0, "HOUR", text_color = #6b7280, text_size = sd3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(sd3_tbl, 1, 0, "AVG RANGE", text_color = #6b7280, text_size = sd3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    sd3_max = 0.0
    for sd3_i = 0 to 23
        sd3_c = array.get(sd3_cnt, sd3_i)
        sd3_v = sd3_c > 0 ? array.get(sd3_sum, sd3_i) / sd3_c : 0.0
        sd3_max := math.max(sd3_max, sd3_v)
    for sd3_i = 0 to 23
        sd3_c = array.get(sd3_cnt, sd3_i)
        sd3_v = sd3_c > 0 ? array.get(sd3_sum, sd3_i) / sd3_c : 0.0
        sd3_col = sd3_max > 0 and sd3_v >= sd3_max * 0.75 ? #c9a84c : #9aa0a6
        table.cell(sd3_tbl, 0, sd3_i + 1, str.tostring(sd3_i) + ":00", text_color = #9aa0a6, text_size = sd3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
        table.cell(sd3_tbl, 1, sd3_i + 1, str.tostring(sd3_v, format.mintick), text_color = sd3_col, text_size = sd3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)

// ---------- DESSERT ----------
ds2_on  = input.bool(true, "Show volatility report", group = "Dessert · Volatility report")
ds2_len = input.int(14, "Report ATR length", minval = 1,    group = "Dessert · Volatility report")
ds2_sz  = input.string("Tiny", "Report text size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = "Dessert · Volatility report")
ds2_pos = input.string("Bottom right", "Volatility report position", options = ["Top right", "Top left", "Bottom right", "Bottom left"], group = "Dessert · Volatility report")

ds2_atr   = ta.atr(ds2_len)
ds2_atr20 = ta.sma(ds2_atr, 20)
ds2_datr  = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", ta.atr(ds2_len), lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
ds2_watr  = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W", ta.atr(ds2_len), lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
ds2_rel   = ds2_atr20 > 0 ? 100.0 * ds2_atr / ds2_atr20 : 0.0
ds2_col   = ds2_rel > 120 ? #c9a84c : ds2_rel < 80 ? #9aa0a6 : #00abff

ds2_size = ds2_sz == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : ds2_sz == "Small" ? size.small : ds2_sz == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.large

ds2_where = ds2_pos == "Top right" ? position.top_right : ds2_pos == "Top left" ? position.top_left : ds2_pos == "Bottom right" ? position.bottom_right : position.bottom_left

var table ds2_t = table.new(ds2_where, 2, 5, border_width = 0)
ds2_row(r, k, v, c) =>
    table.cell(ds2_t, 0, r, k, text_color = #6b7280, text_size = ds2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds2_t, 1, r, v, text_color = c,       text_size = ds2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)

if ds2_on and barstate.islast
    table.cell(ds2_t, 0, 0, "VOLATILITY", text_color = #c9a84c, text_size = ds2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds2_t, 1, 0, "", bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    ds2_row(1, "ATR (chart)", str.tostring(ds2_atr,  format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    ds2_row(2, "ATR daily",   str.tostring(ds2_datr, format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    ds2_row(3, "ATR weekly",  str.tostring(ds2_watr, format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    ds2_row(4, "vs 20 avg",   str.tostring(ds2_rel, "#") + "%", ds2_col)
